name: create_project
description: Create a Linear project, optionally attaching external links.

lead.description: Optional project lead, by user name or "me".

target_date.description: Optional target date as an ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD.

links.description: Optional comma-separated list of external URLs to attach to the project, for example "https://figma.com/file/abc,https://example.com/spec".
